messages:
Alex (AE): Heads-up: Altura CISO just pushed back on SSO + KMS + data residency. They're asking for BYO-KMS + SAML idp + contract SLA 99.95 and pricing commitment for Q3. Need exec support to keep POC on schedule. Can SE/Legal confirm what we can offer by EOD?
Mina (SE): On SSO: we can support SAML/OIDC. For BYO-KMS, Private deploy supports customer KMS — needs config & infra lead. Timeline: ~2 week prep + validation. Raj (Legal): We need exact data flow + egress terms. Are they insisting on a DPA change or just an appendix?
Alex (AE): They said DPA + appendix for BYO-KMS. Also need per-route throughput SLO for 1k rps during demo window. Joan (VP Sales): Tagging @Mina and @Lisa. We can do a one-time SLA for the demo with a bridge, but need an internal signoff. Mina, how risky is 1k rps for Dedicated vs Hosted?
Mina (SE): Dedicated GPU pool with reserved capacity meets 1k rps for short window. Risk: cold starts and large batch spikes. Suggest pre-warm and prefix caching. We'll need 3 nodes reserved + autoscale CPU buffer.
Lisa (Security): For BYO-KMS we require attestation: key policy, rotation schedule, and IAM roles. I'll draft an SSQ response and a minimal KMS checklist.
Alex (AE): Customer exec wants pricing concession if we commit to the SLA. What's our threshold for demonstration-level SLA discount?
Joan (VP Sales): We can offer a 30% demo credit for dedicated capacity, tied to a two-week reserved window. Need finance sign-off. @Raj can you expedite DPA appendix?
Raj (Legal): I'll prep a DPA appendix template. Two asks: (1) confirm region (EU-data residency?), (2) indemnity caps - need final decision from finance.
devops-bot: New private-deploy request created: ticket #INC-5281 (Altura BYO-KMS). Assigned to @mkg.
Mina (SE): Action plan:
- SE config guide + KMS checklist (today)
- Infra reservation request (by 10:30 PT)
- Legal DPA appendix draft (Raj, EOD)
- Pricing concession note (Joan/Alex, finance)
Alex (AE): I'll sync with customer for a 4/3 demo window and ask for written confirmation on DPA needs. If we get buy-in, can we lock infra by end of day?
Joan (VP Sales): Yes, lock if Finance approves pricing note. I'll loop @Kara (Finance) now. @Kara please advise on discount approval threshold.
Kara (Finance): 30% for a single two-week reserved demo is fine; require PO or contract addendum. Approve subject to legal appendix.
Lisa (Security): Sending KMS checklist now. Quick Q: do we support HSM-backed keys? If they need HSM, it'll shift timeline.
Alex (AE): Customer said HSM preferred but not mandatory. I'll clarify. Thanks everyone — will update after customer confirmation. :raising_hand:
